name: God Rays
desc: Volumetric light shafts fanning from a corner with dust motes drifting inside, the whole fan swinging slowly while brightness tracks the musical intensity.

spread.doc: angular width of the fan + beam taper

style.doc: volumetric=soft warm additive shafts / cathedral=hard stained-glass colored beams w/ leaded edges / crepuscular=atmospheric graded haze / scanline=CRT phosphor banded light (abstract) / blueprint=schematic ray-diagram vectors + angle arc (abstract)

act.doc: dawn=slow brighten/dim breathing / flicker=clouds pass and occlude intermittently / noon=steady strong beams
